subject: Archer portal: scope boundary and ephemeral credential upload instructions
messages:
From: Lena Park <lena.park@archertech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Archer Onboarding <onboarding@archertech.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Archer portal onboarding — initial scope & credential questions

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for choosing Archer for vendor questionnaire hosting. We're starting the onboarding for Redwood and need a few clarifications so we can correctly scope the portal profile and evidence buckets. I've attached our standard onboarding checklist (archer_onboard_checklist.pdf). Quick asks: 

- Which product surface(s) will be in scope? (Hosted API / Dedicated pools / Private deployment)
- Data residency: do you need any EU-only evidence buckets or is US-only fine for now?
- Ephemeral credential model: we support short-lived service accounts (TLT) and temporary presigned uploads. What TTL do you prefer for portal upload tokens? 12h / 24h / 72h?
- Do you want us to map CAIQ sections for SOC2 evidence ingestion, or will you upload a CAIQ fragment CSV?
- For KMS/proof-of-possession artifacts: will Redwood provide signed attestations or do you want to upload key metadata to our secure bucket?

If you can reply with a filled scope matrix (I included a blank template in the portal), we can provision the profile and send a secure upload link.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Lena Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Archer Tech

Attachments: archer_onboard_checklist.pdf (PDF, 92KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@archertech.com>
Cc: Archer Onboarding <onboarding@archertech.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:34:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal onboarding — initial scope & credential questions

Lena — thanks for the checklist, and great to get this started. Short answers up front, more detail below and I've attached a filled scope matrix (redwood_scope_matrix.xlsx).

Summary:
- Products in scope: Hosted API + Dedicated GPU pools. Private deployment (VPC) is out of scope for this onboarding wave.
- Data residency: US-only for this account (no EU buckets required).
- Preferred TTL for portal upload tokens: 24 hours (we prefer short lived but need a full working day for our ops windows).
- CAIQ: please accept a CAIQ fragment CSV — we'll upload caig_mapping_v2.csv and would appreciate it if you can map it to your portal fields.
- KMS/proof artifacts: we'll provide signed key-holder attestations (PDF) and a metadata CSV; we do not want to share private keys.

Notes / attachments:
- redwood_scope_matrix.xlsx (attached) contains proposed profile fields, environment tags, and sample SSO metadata if you need it.
- We'll add a short summary doc for how our ephemeral token rotation works; for portal-side rotation we can also support a 30-day service-account rotation policy if that helps auditability.

Can you confirm Archer's expected field name for CAIQ section IDs (we use caig_section_id v2 in our CSV) so the mapping matches? Also please send the secure upload link and any required CSV schema; we'll drop the CAIQ fragment and the signed attestations there.

Thanks — looping in Karthik and Mina for technical confirmation on token TTL and evidence formats.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_scope_matrix.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Archer portal onboarding — TTL and evidence formats (internal)

Karthik / Mina — forwarding Lena's questions and our reply. Two quick risks / asks for design: 

1) TTL for upload tokens: I'm proposing 24h to balance ops convenience and security. Can we accept temporary presigned tokens with 24h TTL via our lambda-ingest gateway? Any change to how we mint or validate that would be a blocker.

2) CAIQ fragment format: they asked for caig_section_id v2. Mina, can you review the CSV schema attached and confirm we can export the mapping they expect (we currently have a CAIQ export utility but it uses a slightly different header). If we need a mapping script I can prioritize it.

If both items are green, I'll confirm back to Archer and upload the CSV + signed attestations into their portal link.

—Marcus

From: Lena Park <lena.park@archertech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Archer Onboarding <onboarding@archertech.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal onboarding — initial scope & credential questions

Thanks Marcus — that's perfect, and the scope matrix helped. Quick confirmations and next steps: 

- TTL: 24h is fine. We'll provision presigned upload tokens valid for 24 hours.
- CAIQ mapping: Archer expects the header caig_section_id (v2 compatible). Upload caig_mapping_v2.csv and we'll auto-map; if any rows fail mapping we'll send a mapping report back.
- KMS artifacts: upload signed attestations only — do NOT upload private keys. We'll store the attestations in the evidence bucket and reference them in the SOC2/CAIQ attachments.
- Rotation: we can record your 30-day service-account rotation policy as part of the profile notes. If you can provide a short statement (1-2 sentences) confirming rotation cadence we'll attach it to the profile.

Upload link: https://vendor-portal.archertech.com/upload/REDW-9981 (expires 7/30/2028). Please place the following files in the root of the upload: 
  - redwood_scope_matrix.xlsx
  - caig_mapping_v2.csv
  - signed_key_attestations.zip (zip containing PDFs)

I'll kick off a quick portal QA after upload and send you the mapping report within 24 hours. Let me know if you want me to create the CAIQ mapping for you instead (we can do a one-time mapping for small exports).

If everything looks good I'll mark the profile as provisioned and share the view-only link for your security team.

Best,
Lena Park
Vendor Onboarding Lead, Archer Tech
